# Quantum Records and Coherence

Question and principal result: README.md
Connected scientific route and claim-to-proof map: science/README.md
Exact model, actual visibility and quantum/classical reduction: science/model.md
Independent endpoint, finite-size converse and sharp asymptotic coefficient: science/sharp-bound.md
Matching mixture and explicit linear-gate star circuit: science/constructions.md
Exactly pairwise-independent bounded-correlation construction: science/pairwise-independence.md
Physical interpretation and load-bearing limitations: science/scope.md
Attribution and unresolved full-text comparisons: references/related-work.md
Reproduction, checked scope and output: verification/README.md
Executable checks: verification/check_records.py
Stored checked output: verification/results.json

Preserve these distinctions: selected fragments versus exhaustive pure environment;
actual visibility versus a compatible fidelity envelope; conditional errors versus
average error; fixed-positive-budget asymptotics versus varying-budget limits;
pairwise versus joint independence; written proof versus finite numerical checks;
reconstructed mathematics versus verified priority. Additional purifiers are
explicitly outside the constrained record partition. No educational anchor has
yet been selected, and no personal coaching procedure belongs in this repository.
